products.name: NUTRILITE® All Plant Protein Powder
products.usp: 100% plant-sourced unflavored tri-blend (Soy, Wheat, Pea) yielding a complete PDCAAS 1.0 profile, 80% protein density, cookable into daily staples without nutrient degradation.

clinical_nutrition_rationale.what_it_is: A tri-peptide plant protein isolate complex formulated from non-GMO soy protein isolate, wheat protein concentrate, and yellow pea protein isolate. It delivers an 80% pure protein yield (8.0g intact protein per 10g scoop) supplying all 9 essential amino acids (EAAs) in precise stoichiometric balance. The formulation is naturally unflavored, devoid of added sucrose, cholesterol, synthetic excipients, or artificial sweeteners, and is thermally stable up to boiling temperatures.
clinical_nutrition_rationale.why_it_is_needed: Over 70% of Indian diets suffer from severe primary protein deficits (<0.6g/kg/day vs recommended 0.83-1.0g/kg/day), characterized by cereal-heavy, lysine-poor carbohydrate overconsumption. This chronic deficit triggers sarcopenic obesity, impaired cellular immunity, and delayed wound/collagen healing. All Plant Protein solves this without adding saturated fat or cholesterol. Combining legumes (high in lysine, low in methionine) with grain peptides (high in methionine) achieves a biological Protein Digestibility-Corrected Amino Acid Score (PDCAAS) of 1.0, matching the gold-standard bioavailability of egg and milk protein while remaining 100% dairy- and lactose-free.

medical_standards_validation.standard_authority: WHO/FAO/UNU Expert Consultation (TRS 935) & ICMR-NIN 2020 RDA for Indians

products.name: XS™ Whey Protein Powder Formula 2 Chocolate
products.usp: Multi-stage biphasic release formula (6 protein blend: fast whey + slow caseins) fortified with 5g BCAAs and prebiotic inulin for zero bloating and sustained 8-hour muscle recovery.

clinical_nutrition_rationale.what_it_is: A targeted athletic sports nutrition formulation combining 6 distinct fractionated dairy proteins: Whey Protein Hydrolysate, Whey Protein Isolate, Whey Protein Concentrate, Milk Protein Isolate, Sodium Caseinate, and Calcium Caseinate. Each 30g scoop delivers 23g intact protein, 10g Essential Amino Acids (EAAs), 5g Branched-Chain Amino Acids (BCAAs: Leucine, Isoleucine, Valine in a 2:1:1 ratio), 80mg elemental calcium, and prebiotic chicory inulin, with zero added sucrose.
clinical_nutrition_rationale.why_it_is_needed: During intense resistance training or athletic conditioning, muscle myofibrillar breakdown sharply accelerates. Conventional pure whey isolates cause a rapid spike in blood amino acids (hyperaminoacidemia) that quickly peaks and drops within 90 minutes, leading to excessive hepatic nitrogen oxidation and early return to a catabolic state. Furthermore, concentrated whey often causes uncomfortable gastric bloating and distension. XS Formula 2 solves both problems: hydrolyzed/isolate fractions immediately trigger the mTOR anabolic switch via the leucine trigger, while micellar and calcium caseinates sustain plasma amino acid concentrations for up to 8 hours. The prebiotic inulin nourishes colonic bifidobacteria, preventing protein fermentation and post-workout gastrointestinal distress.

clinical_nutrition_rationale.what_it_is: A functional wellness protein powder pairing Nutrilite's tri-source plant protein matrix (Soy, Wheat, and Yellow Pea) with standardized Green Tea Extract (*Camellia sinensis*). Each serving delivers 8.0g of complete plant protein, combined with 250mg of green tea extract yielding rich concentrations of Epigallocatechin Gallate (EGCG) and polyphenol catechins, flavored with natural green tea essence.
clinical_nutrition_rationale.why_it_is_needed: Modern metabolic health is threatened by a dual challenge: chronic sub-clinical protein deficiency and systemic oxidative stress induced by urban pollution, poor lipid diets, and sedentary lifestyles. Protein is required for cellular repair, while polyphenols protect the vascular endothelium from lipid peroxidation. This product solves both by combining a complete amino acid profile (PDCAAS 1.0) with therapeutic catechins. EGCG acts as a potent free radical scavenger and modest thermogenic enhancer, while the plant protein preserves fat-free mass and promotes postprandial satiety.

products.usp: Pediatric nutritional drink mix providing bioavailable plant protein, elemental calcium, iron, and essential B-vitamins in a delicious cocoa base to bridge fussy-eater nutritional deficits.

clinical_nutrition_rationale.what_it_is: A pediatric dietary beverage mix engineered for growing children aged 5 years and older. It features high-quality plant protein isolate combined with milk solids, enriched with elemental Calcium, Iron, Vitamin C, Vitamin D, and B-complex vitamins in a palatable natural cocoa matrix with controlled sugars.
clinical_nutrition_rationale.why_it_is_needed: Childhood and early adolescence represent critical windows of skeletal mineralization and myofibrillar growth. Indian pediatric diets are notoriously low in bioavailable protein and minerals, exacerbated by widespread 'fussy eating' habits where children consume calorie-dense but nutrient-poor processed foods. This results in stunted bone density accretion, poor concentration, and low ferritin stores. Nutrilite Kids Drink solves this by providing growing bodies with essential structural building blocks (protein + calcium + vitamin D) to support linear growth, alongside iron to prevent pediatric microcytic anemia, packaged in a format children willingly consume.
